en: Vintage sepia photographic postcard showing six costumed theatre actors posed in a studio setting. They wear early 20th‑century formal and theatrical outfits including top hats, feathered hats, gowns and coats. At the top left is the title 'Der Graf von Luxemburg' and 'Centraltheater.' At the top right is a German phrase. Along the bottom are the printed names of the actors, and in the lower right corner appears the photographer's imprint with place and year 'Dresden 1910.'
